prompt: What are the two largest bear species in the world today, in terms of largest average size, and largest maximum size range?
judge_reasoning: Candidate [1] is the most directly responsive: it identifies polar bears as the largest by average size and pairs them with brown bears for the largest size/mass category, with relatively consistent supporting figures. Candidate [3] ultimately names brown bears and polar bears, but it also contains substantial incorrect/irrelevant intermediate claims (sloth bears, giant pandas) and the response never cleanly maps which species satisfies “largest average size” vs “largest maximum size range.” Candidates [2] and [4] incorrectly elevate sloth bears into the “largest” set and therefore fail the core factual requirements.
